title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How PonyLife collects, uses, and protects information when you use the website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how PonyLife collects and processes information when you access the website and related services.
We aim to collect only what is necessary to operate, secure, and improve the platform.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
bullets: Account information (e.g., username, email, authentication data)
User-generated content (e.g., uploaded media and descriptions of Works)
Usage data (e.g., pages viewed, interactions, approximate device/browser info)
Technical logs for security and debugging (e.g., IP address, timestamps)

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Information
bullets: To provide and maintain platform functionality (accounts, submissions, catalog)
To secure the website and prevent abuse or fraud
To improve user experience and platform performance
To communicate service-related messages (e.g., updates, notices)

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis and Consent
paragraphs: Depending on your jurisdiction, processing may rely on consent, contract performance, legitimate interests, or legal obligations.
Where consent is required, you may withdraw consent by contacting us or using available controls.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information.
We may share information with service providers who help operate the website (hosting, analytics, security), subject to reasonable confidentiality and security commitments.
We may disclose information if required by law or to protect safety, rights, and integrity of the platform.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and Analytics
paragraphs: We may use cookies or similar technologies to support basic functionality, preferences, and analytics.
You can control cookies through browser settings. Some features may not work properly if cookies are disabled.

sections.heading: 7. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable administrative and technical safeguards designed to protect information.
No method of transmission or storage is fully secure; therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 8. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain information as long as necessary to provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.
Creators may request deletion of account data, subject to legal and operational constraints (e.g., security logs, compliance).

sections.heading: 9. Your Rights
bullets: Access, correction, or deletion of certain personal data
Objection or restriction in certain cases (depending on jurisdiction)
Data portability in certain cases (depending on jurisdiction)

sections.heading: 10. International Transfers
paragraphs: If you access the platform from outside the region where our servers are located, information may be transferred across borders.
We take reasonable measures to protect information in accordance with this policy.

sections.heading: 11. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated date reflects the most recent revision.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact PonyLife via the official channels listed on the website.
